description: This is a Java source file implementing product-related services within the Apache OFBiz framework. It contains multiple methods for managing product variants, features, associated products, virtual product creation, image handling, and product updates based on shipment activities. The class 'ProductServices' provides service methods for manipulating product entities, creating feature trees, finding variants, handling images, and other product operations.

classes.name: ProductServices
classes.description: This class provides static service methods for product management within the OFBiz framework, including variant handling, feature trees, virtual product creation, product updates, and image processing.

methods.name: prodFindAllVariants
methods.description: Creates a collection of all variant products for a given product ID.

methods.name: prodFindFeatureTypes
methods.description: Retrieves a sequence of feature types associated with a product.

methods.name: prodMakeFeatureTree
methods.description: Builds a nested feature tree for variants.

methods.name: prodGetFeatures
methods.description: Retrieves features of a product, filtered by type or distinctiveness.

methods.name: prodFindProduct
methods.description: Finds a product entity by product ID, resolving variants if applicable.

methods.name: prodFindAssociatedByType
methods.description: Finds products associated with a given product by specified association type.

methods.name: makeGroup
methods.description: Helper method to build a hierarchical grouping of features (internal use).

methods.name: makeVariantSample
methods.description: Helper method to create a sample variant based on features (internal use).

methods.name: quickAddVariant
methods.description: Adds a new variant to a product, duplicating and associating features.

methods.name: quickCreateVirtualWithVariants
methods.description: Creates a virtual product and associates variants with it without primary features.

methods.name: updateProductIfAvailableFromShipment
methods.description: Reactivates a product based on shipment inventory conditions.

methods.name: addAdditionalViewForProduct
methods.description: Handles image upload and processing for additional product views, including scaling and storage.
